description: We're Heidi. We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries. Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world's healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart. We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. If you don't choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi. The role Heidi's UK and Europe business is growing faster than the finance scaffolding underneath it. Central finance across Sydney, Melbourne and Manila runs month-end close, core accounting and day-to-day operations, but the region needs someone on the ground who owns the accuracy of its numbers and sits close enough to the commercial team to shape decisions before they get made. Today, regional leaders wait on Australian hours for answers about their own P&L. You'll end that. The role has two halves and both carry equal weight. You'll own regional financial control and compliance: the integrity of the balance sheet, the accuracy of management reporting and forecasts, cash, strong local controls, and statutory obligations across Companies House, HMRC and VAT, directed through external advisers. You'll also be a hands-on business partner to UK and Europe leadership, Sales and Customer Success, owning the P&L narrative, bringing a commercial view to pricing, deal terms and customer economics, and making sure teams see the financial consequence of the choices they make. You'll report to the Group Financial Controller with a dotted line to FP&A. This is not a support role for the commercial team. The Investor Relations team supports investors, financial advisors, and home office personnel, assisting them with their investments on iCapital’s technology platform, and works closely with fund sponsors using iCapital’s platform for distribution. The team’s goal is to optimize the user experience and ensure our clients’ overall success.     Responsibilities Help financial advisors and high‑net‑worth investors through the entire onboarding process by ensuring subscription and AML documents are accurate, complete, and compliant. Clearly explain what needs to be fixed when documents don’t meet requirements. Deliver white-glove service to financial advisors and high-net-worth investors by providing responsive, high-touch support throughout the onboarding process on the iCapital platform. Build trust through professionalism, reliability, and a solutions-oriented mindset. Communicate effectively with advisors, investors, and internal partners via email, calls, and platform-based interactions, translating complex requirements into clear, actionable guidance. Proactively identify onboarding obstacles, including incomplete documentation or platform-related questions, and resolve them efficiently to minimize friction and delays for clients. Liaise with internal teams and third-party vendors to ensure all messaging to clients is accurate and delivered in a timely fashion.   Qualifications Strong Bachelor’s Degree with more than 3 years of experience in financial services, preferably in a client service or investor relations role in alternative investments Fluency in English is required, written and verbal. Other languages are a plus. Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail Interpersonal communication skills, written and verbal Able to meet hard deadlines and work effectively under pressure Proven ability to multi-task and work both independently and as a team player Proficient computer skills, specifically Microsoft Office applications (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) Comfort with or interest in technology Self-motivated, strong work ethic needed Possess desire and ability to learn quickly   We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office 4 days a week with the flexibility to work remotely 1 day ( Friday).
